method: Each definition in s29-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration file runs the real route handler POST /api/v1/buyer/menu-translations and getOrCreateTranslation on local PostgreSQL databases built from the migrations through 0028, with the three Neon URLs removed; OpenAI is faked at the fetch boundary by tests/support/fake-openai.ts, labeled FIXTURE, so no model is called. The unit file reads src/domain/menu/translate.ts, src/integrations/ai/openai.ts and renders src/app/buy/basket-form.tsx. Every definition here is an S29 test recorded in 00-status.md.
